title: The rectangular chart exposes four distinct boundary mechanisms

c_zero.name: radius_coalescence_rademacher
c_zero.law: p=0 in the effective law, b=1 and the a label carries zero mass; the distribution is symmetric Rademacher.

z_one.name: complete_symmetric_three_point
z_one.law: a=0, p=c/(c+1), b=1+c; the two inner atoms coalesce at zero.

z_zero.name: rare_atom_growing_support
z_zero.law: p tends to one, a tends to one, b=1+c/z diverges and outer mass z^2/(c+z^2) vanishes.
z_zero.moment_warning: Variance stays one and m4=1+c, while every fixed moment above four diverges for fixed c>0; weak Rademacher convergence is not uniform moment convergence.
z_zero.fisher_type: requires a dedicated rare-atom collar bound

c_two_minus_q.name: zero_gaussian_noise_singular_face
c_two_minus_q.law: u=q, t=1 and v=0 for every 0<z<=1.
c_two_minus_q.fisher_type: +infinity in the extended relative-Fisher convention for the discrete pushforward

joint_corner.name: rare_atom_zero_noise_corner
joint_corner.warning: The joint (c,z)->(2-q,0) limit is not licensed by either one-face statement and needs a two-parameter collar argument.

scope_guard: Boundary typing identifies the obligations of a global proof; it does not prove collar separation or continuity at the rare-atom corner.
